summary: Build practical NLP skills with text cleaning, classification, NER, and reporting. Train your team to turn text into decisions.
lede: Text analytics and natural language processing for business helps you transform comments, emails, tickets, reports, and other unstructured text into structured, decision-ready outputs. You will practise preprocessing, TF-IDF feature design, sentiment scoring, named entity recognition, classification, and topic modelling using practical machine learning workflows. The course shows you how to build and validate baseline NLP models with accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score, then turn results into entity tables, sentiment summaries, dashboards, and text classification reports. With tools and methods including spaCy, scikit-learn, logistic regression, Naive Bayes, LDA, and an operational introduction to transformer-based approaches and Hugging Face, you can apply repeatable pipelines across customer experience, risk review, research support, and internal operations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle text-rich business data and need structured NLP methods they can apply immediately.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of spreadsheets, basic statistics, and data analysis concepts; familiarity with Python is helpful but not required for completion. You should be comfortable reviewing business datasets and interpreting charts or tables. A laptop is required for hands-on labs, and the course is best suited to professionals ready to work with text data, baseline machine learning, and practical NLP workflows. Advanced transformer implementation is covered at a conceptual and operational level, not as production engineering.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
